pages.text: Something Is Here
pages.subtext: The Star Door Mystery
pages.alt: Mira, Pip and six friendly original 3D travellers gather in a warm observatory around a parcel, route map and brass Star Door.

pages.alt: Tavi stands in the observatory library beside the route-map stand.

pages.text:
Before breakfast, Mira heard a CLUNK.

The sleeping Star Door had woken.
pages.subtext: What do you think made the sound?
pages.alt: Tavi and Sol look toward the closed brass-and-blue Star Door in the observatory.

pages.text:
A folded note slid through the brass slot.

FIND NOTHING.
FIVE CLUES WILL SHOW THE WAY.
pages.subtext: Mira read the note twice. The crew leaned closer.
pages.alt: The Star Door, a real folded note and a map with five unlit star spaces are visible.

pages.text:
Sol bounced on his toes.
“Easy! I find things that are not there all the time.”

Tavi smiled. “Then let us look carefully.”
pages.subtext: Tavi is a careful spotter. A tiny book code is hiding in the room.
pages.alt: Sol grins while Tavi looks carefully around the observatory. The optional code ROOMSTAR is hidden in the scene.

pages.text:
The map showed five dark stars.
Mira tucked the note into her pocket.

The crew followed the first golden arrow.
pages.subtext: Trace the route with your finger. Where does it begin?
pages.alt: The crew stands beside the parcel and the five-star route map at the start of the journey.

pages.text:
Sol opened the parcel.
“My toy!” he cheered.

Lift the toy out of the box.
pages.subtext: Use your finger to show where the toy should go.
pages.alt: Sol and Tavi stand beside an open parcel with a recognisable teddy toy inside.

pages.text:
Sol peered inside.
“Now the box has nothing in it!”

What is still here?
pages.subtext: Say or point before you turn the page.
pages.alt: The teddy is outside the open box. Sol peers into the box while Tavi watches.

pages.text:
TOY OUTSIDE.
BOX HERE.

“Empty means the toy is not inside,” said Tavi.
The first star lit.
pages.subtext: The empty box did not disappear. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: The open box and teddy outside it are clearly labelled. The optional code BOXCLUE is hidden near the parcel.

pages.text:
The first star opened a blue door.

Beyond it, three brass bells swayed in the wind.
pages.subtext: The crew followed Nori into the bell gallery.
pages.alt: Nori and Tavi enter a gallery containing three large recognisable brass bells.

pages.text:
Then the wind stopped.
The big bell hung still.

Cup your hand to your ear. What can you hear?
pages.subtext: Wait for one slow breath before you turn.
pages.alt: Nori leans toward a large still brass bell while Tavi waits nearby.

pages.text:
“No ring,” whispered Nori.
“But I heard my breath, and the bell stayed here.”

The second star lit.
pages.subtext: No ring means the bell did not ring during this short listen. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: Nori listening and the still bell are labelled. The optional code QUIETWINGS is hidden on a brass detail.

pages.text:
The second star opened a paper room.
Vee found a cream card.

“It has nothing on it. Shall we test that?”
pages.subtext: The card and a chunky pencil wait on the round table.
pages.alt: Vee and Tavi stand in a paper room beside a recognisable blank cream card and pencil.

pages.text:
Use your finger in the air.
Pretend to make a mark—or leave the card blank.

What stays?
pages.subtext: Both choices are allowed. Choose before you turn.
pages.alt: A large blank cream card is ready for an imaginary finger mark while Vee waits without choosing for the child.

pages.text:
MARK HERE—or BLANK CARD HERE.

A blank card is still a card.
The third star lit.
pages.subtext: Neither choice made nothing appear. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: One card has a visible mark and one card remains blank; both are labelled. The optional code BLANKEDGE is hidden near a card edge.

pages.text:
The card made seven wall tiles glow.

Moss looked up. “They want us to step a word.”
pages.subtext: Seven separate coloured tiles wait across the wall.
pages.alt: Moss and Vee look up at seven separate glowing wall tiles.

pages.text:
Point to each tile as you read:

N   O   T   H   I   N   G
pages.subtext: Go slowly from left to right.
pages.alt: Seven large labelled tiles spell N O T H I N G from left to right above Moss and Vee.

pages.text:
“Nothing is a word we can see, say and read,” said Moss.

The fourth star lit.
pages.subtext: The word stayed visible after the crew named it.
pages.alt: The seven visible letter tiles still spell NOTHING while the fourth route star glows.

pages.text:
The fourth star opened a curtain passage.

“I can make Sol’s toy vanish,” said Luma. “Watch!”
pages.subtext: Luma carried the toy to a red curtain.
pages.alt: Luma holds Sol's recognisable teddy beside a large red curtain while Sol watches.

pages.text:
Luma pulled the red curtain shut.
Sol’s toy disappeared from view.

Has the toy gone?
pages.subtext: What can you still see? Decide before you turn.
pages.alt: The large red curtain is closed. Luma and Sol remain visible beside it.

pages.text:
Luma opened the curtain.
“There it is! Hidden is not gone.”

The fifth star lit.
pages.subtext: The curtain changed what the crew could see. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: The red curtain is open and Sol's teddy is visible again. The optional code CURTAINMAP is hidden in the fabric pattern.

pages.text:
Five stars blazed.

The great Star Door rolled open with a golden WHOOSH.
pages.subtext: The whole journey had led back to the door.
pages.alt: Five stars glow on the great Star Door while Tavi, Nori and Moss look up.

pages.text:
Two little doors waited.
Door A offered a card.
Door B offered no object.

Which door showed nothing?
pages.subtext: Inspect both doors before you decide.
pages.alt: Door A has a visible cream card on its shelf. Door B has the same shelf with no object on it.

pages.text:
Look at Door A. It showed a card.

Look at Door B. It showed no object.

Choose carefully before you turn.
pages.subtext: Do not add a secret object that the picture did not show.
pages.alt: The two little doors are labelled: A shows a card; B shows no object.

pages.text:
“Neither,” said Tavi.

“A showed a card. B showed no object, so we do not invent one.”
pages.subtext: The note’s puzzle is solved. Find the final hidden optional code.
pages.alt: Tavi, Nori and Moss stand between both checked doors. The optional code TWODOORS is hidden near the route map.

pages.text:
Mira read the old note again:
FIND NOTHING.

The crew had found empty, quiet, blank and hidden things—but no nothing.
pages.subtext: Inside this careful story check: there is no nothing.
pages.alt: The original note and completed five-star map are shown beside Tavi and Sol.

pages.text:
On the way to the library, the first star blinked.

Tavi asked, “What did Sol call empty?”

Think back. Do not turn yet.
pages.subtext: The first clue is waiting somewhere in this room.
pages.alt: Tavi asks a question in the library while an open box and teddy are visible as separate choices.

pages.text:
The BOX was empty.
The TOY was outside.

You brought an earlier clue back to mind.
pages.subtext: Remember means to bring an earlier clue back to mind.
pages.alt: The open box and teddy outside it are labelled in the library recall scene.

pages.text:
Mira slid the map into the library stand.

“We found no nothing,” she said, “and we never had to pretend.”
pages.subtext: Every star now had a story the crew could retell.
pages.alt: The crew files the completed five-star map in the child-height library stand.

pages.text:
1. Name what is here.
2. Say what changed.
3. Never add a secret answer.

Can you use the trick on one clue?
pages.subtext: Tavi may ask how you looked. Tavi never gives away a new answer.
pages.alt: Tavi stands beside three large numbered stars representing look, compare and do not invent.

pages.text:
The Star Door chimed.

A blue-and-gold parcel rolled into the library.
Sol grinned. “Another mystery?”
pages.subtext: The first adventure is complete. The next one is only beginning.
pages.alt: A new blue-and-gold parcel waits by the library chute while Sol and Tavi notice it.

pages.text:
On its label was one question:

How can ONE whole have many parts?
pages.subtext: Next: Book E02 · One Whole, Many Parts
pages.alt: Tavi, Sol and Vee gather near the new parcel in the sunrise library.
